description: Reference choreography from the @lina.summee TikTok (9.67 s, solo, full body, static camera). The dancer walks in from the left edge during the first 0.8 s and is tracked in every frame to the end (no absent end card). Move boundaries from the wrist/elbow/knee/ankle trajectories and motion energy of data/dance/pose/lina_summee_435de6.npz (see docs/DANCE_MODEL_INTERFACE.md section 4 for the schema).

moves.name: Walk in from the left edge turning to face the camera, hands lifting to the shoulders
Hands held up beside the head with fingers spread and a small bounce, then pulled in beside the cheeks with elbows out wide
Arms drop and hang low by the hips while the body sways side to side
Both arms swing out and up overhead as one foot crosses in, then one arm lowers
One hand held up beside the head with the other hand at the hip, then both hands rise to the face
Arms swing down with a knee lift and side kick, then hands go to the head with a high kick to the other side
Arms hang loose at the sides, feet apart, small sway
One arm swings up overhead with a low kick out to the side, then both hands come to the head
Hands lower from the head to the chest with a cross step and a small turn of the body to finish

notes: All 17 COCO joints are visible in >=93% of frames (ankles 100%), so the 'legs' fault can fire on this dance.
The dancer is never absent: ok=True for all 290 frames; the last move ends at the last ok frame (289, 9.633 s).

'ready' is the count-in: the dancer enters from the left edge side-on and turns to face the camera, so it is not a still pose; the judge's reference clock starts count_in_s after the first ok learner frame unless set_ref_clock is used.

Kicks: at 6.1-6.4 s the npz-left knee lifts with the foot out to image right; at 6.8-6.9 s the npz-right leg kicks high to image left; at 8.2-8.3 s the npz-right foot extends low to image left. Move names avoid left/right because the clip is mirrored.
No clearly periodic move (autocorrelation of hip/shoulder height and motion energy shows no beat-rate peak), so bpm is left null.
